resources.string: Open the session to see what happened.
An agent needs you. Open Rafiq to answer.
A session stopped with an error.
Your server could not be reached. Open Rafiq to try again.
The agent is busy. Open Rafiq to send it when it is free.
Your server did not take it: %1$s
Asking your server for the approval
Your server could not be reached. Nothing was sent.
Confirm it is you before Rafiq answers on your server

An approval lets the agent run a command on your server. With this on, approving needs a fingerprint, unless you unlocked your phone with one in the last 30 seconds. Adding a new fingerprint turns it off until you turn it on again.
Your phone\'s fingerprints or face changed, so the approval lock turned off and nothing was sent. Turn it on again in Settings to keep it.
The approval lock turned off because your phone\'s fingerprints or face changed. Turn it on again to keep it.
This phone could not make the approval lock\'s key, so the lock stays off.
Notifications need a UnifiedPush app on your phone. Install ntfy, then come back and tap Set up.
More than one push app is installed. Choose the one Rafiq should use.
%1$s needs you to do something in its own app first.
%1$s asks for a key Rafiq does not send. Use ntfy instead.
%1$s did not set up push. Tap Set up to try again.
Your server refused this phone\'s push address: %1$s
Your server could not be reached. Rafiq tries again when the network is back.
Let Rafiq fetch details in the background
Without this, a sleeping phone may show only \"An agent needs you\" instead of the request.
Pushes arrive through %1$s. Open its settings and set battery use to Unrestricted, so pushes are not held back while your phone sleeps.
